notes: A chain of 600 nested Lets (graph depth 602) in shallow, flat JSON: the JSON depth cap never fires, but the canonical encoder, hash walk, verifier and interpreter all recurse once per graph level, and a chain of about 1,000 overflowed the JVM stack with a raw StackOverflowError during hashing (review H3). Ingest computes graph depth iteratively alongside the cycle check and rejects it against the maxGraphDepth cap (512).
